title: Production Platform Realization
objective: Replace reference-only infrastructure with explicitly selected production persistence, search, identity, hosting, synchronization and service adapters while preserving the completed MIB contracts.

scope.purpose: Replace reference-only infrastructure with explicitly selected production persistence, search, identity, hosting, synchronization and service adapters while preserving MIB contracts.
scope.completion_gate: Production adapters pass the MIB compliance suites and owner-domain behavior remains unchanged.

selection_boundaries: MIB-18 and the MIB family are completed_verified before SMB selection.
SMB is the owner-approved post-MIB product-completion program.
SMB-01 is selected_not_started only until a subsequent owner Continue governed-starts this attempt.
Selection does not itself choose or activate paid/live providers, production infrastructure, tester distribution, public release, public community features or commerce.

Any production persistence/search/identity/hosting/synchronization/service adapter choice must preserve MIB contracts, pass the MIB compliance suites and satisfy authority/environment conditions at governed start and implementation time.
SMB-02 and later work remain unauthorized until SMB-01 is completed_verified and canonical state advances.
next_action: On the next owner Continue, governed-start SMB-01 under the product-development lane, resolve the permitted production-platform selections from current constraints/evidence, establish a bounded implementation branch and acceptance seam, and execute through its completion gate.
